# resume

## Plugin reference

- Description: Toolbar button that resumes a gone conversation via `claude --resume <claude-id>`; useResumeConversation (the one browser resume, whose failure is a 'Couldn't resume conversation' notification) and that notification's Retry (the resume action kind); useRetryLaunch, which re-runs the launch of a conversation that failed to start.
- Web:
  - Contributes: `Notifications.Action` "resume"
  - Uses:
    - `conversations.useLiveConversation`
    - `infra/endpoints.EndpointError`
    - `infra/endpoints.getEndpointErrorMessage`
    - `infra/endpoints.useFetchEndpoint`
    - `infra/endpoints.useMachineAvailability`
    - `primitives/icon-button.IconButton`
    - `shell/notifications.NotificationActionKind`
    - `shell/notifications.Notifications`
    - `shell/notifications.useToast`
  - Exports (types): `ResumeSubject`
  - Exports (values):
    - `useResumeConversation`
    - `useRetryLaunch`
- Machine:
  - Uses: `infra/endpoints.implementMachine`
  - Routes:
    - `POST /api/conversations/:id/resume`
    - `POST /api/conversations/:id/retry-launch`
- Core:
  - Uses: `infra/endpoints.defineEndpoint`
  - Exports (values):
    - `resumeConversationEndpoint`
    - `retryLaunchEndpoint`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by:
    - `conversations/agent-thread`
    - `conversations/conversation-view/push-and-exit`
    - `conversations/conversation-view/status`
